## Close disposition (force, operator judgment)

AC#1 + AC#4 delivered and landed via Gerrit change 1911 (commit dc2e799bd3, MERGED to main). AC#2 rests on a proven FALSE PREMISE: `clear_absent` is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window pass, so its seeded unconditional-stamp mutation cannot drive the integration test RED (documented in the RCA comment above; the completion verifier independently confirmed the mutation leaves the test GREEN). Operator-attesting AC#2 as met would be dishonest and was withdrawn.

Residual harness gap filed as story 6045-bdf3-ddad-4461 (deiform-filmable-akitainu), linked discovered_from this bug. Closing via --force because the blocking criterion is invalid (false premise), not incomplete — force records no signed completion attestation, which is the correct honest signal here.
